subject: POC orchestration + final readout timing and decision gates
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Elena Soto <elena.soto@carelogix.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@carelogix.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + proposed POC scope and timeline

Hi Elena / Marcus —

Thanks again for taking time today. Short recap from our discovery call and a proposed start plan so we can lock next steps:

Key needs you called out:
- High accuracy for discharge-summary generation (sensitive to PHI redaction)
- 95th-percentile response latency < 600ms for single-prompt autopopulate flows
- On-prem deployment option for PHI routing (we discussed Redwood Private)

Proposed POC scope (30 days):
1) Ingest 2,000 anonymized discharge notes into a staging bucket
2) Run automated generation + redaction pipeline against 200 sampled records
3) Measure: generation accuracy (ROUGE + clinical-entity precision), redaction recall, latency P50/P95, and token cost per record
4) Ops: provide a dedicated test endpoint, KV-cache enabled, and daily sync with your test dataset

Owners / asks:
- CareLogix: provide anonymized sample (owner: Marcus) and procurement contact (procurement@carelogix.com)
- Redwood: POC technical lead (Rishi) and success metrics dashboard (Monica)

Timeline:
- Confirm mutual action plan by 2026-12-03
- POC kickoff 2026-12-07
- Mid-point check (metrics & blockers) 2026-12-21
- Final readout with execs and go/no-go decision window 2027-01-05 to 2027-01-09

Next steps:
- Please review attached Mutual Action Plan and the draft POC success criteria doc. If agreeable, Marcus, can you confirm the sample delivery date and procurement contact?

Thanks — I’ll also loop in our contracts person after you confirm procurement details so we can run the SOW in parallel.

Best,
Camila
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: CareLogix_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx
From: Dr. Elena Soto <elena.soto@carelogix.com>

Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC scope and timeline

Camila —

Appreciate the crisp recap. A couple quick clarifications:
- On accuracy: our clinical team will provide a short gold set (n=100) with target annotations. Can Redwood ingest and evaluate against that gold set automatically?
- The on-prem option is a hard requirement for any PHI-handling portion — can we scope a hybrid where inference runs in our VPC and Redwood handles orchestration/monitoring?

We can get the anonymized sample over the week of 12/6; procurement is looping in procurement@carelogix.com and they asked for a short SOW and ballpark pricing before kickoff.

Marcus — can you confirm sample timeline and share the lead from procurement?

—Elena
VP Clinical Informatics, CareLogix
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Elena Soto <elena.soto@carelogix.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@carelogix.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@carelogix.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC scope and timeline

Thanks Elena — yes, we can automate evaluation against your gold set. Rishi will own the ingest/eval pipeline and will add a script to compute clinical-entity precision/recall.

On the hybrid deployment: we support Redwood Private with a VPC connector that keeps inference in your VPC while sending telemetry to a customer-controlled control plane. I attached a short SOW-draft and the POC success criteria doc for your legal/procurement review.

I’ve tentatively updated the timeline to: kickoff 2026-12-08 (gives you a business day to confirm sample delivery), mid-check 2026-12-22, final readout week 2027-01-06 with an exec review on 2027-01-07 (proposed 11am PT). If that exec slot doesn’t work we can expand the window.

Attachments: POC-Success-Criteria.docx, SOW-draft.pdf

Action items for this thread:
- Marcus: confirm sample delivery by 12/06 and procurement lead contact (reply-all)
- Procurement: quick scan of attached SOW; if ok we’ll push a short SOW + SOW change order to DocuSign for signature before kickoff

Camila

Subject: Internal: prep for CareLogix exec readout (tentative 2027-01-07)

Team —

Looping you both to confirm internal owners and prep checklist for the final readout:
- Rishi: you’ll lead the technical demo and present the evaluation dashboard (show ROUGE, entity precision/recall, and latency P95). Note: ensure PHI redaction test cases are included in the demo.
- Monica: you’ll own the commercial summary (token cost extrapolation, deployment options, recommended pricing/discount path if they go Dedicated or Private).
- I’ll coordinate the agenda with Elena and Marcus and own the decision gate framing (go/no-go criteria + next contract step).

Prep timeline:
- 2026-12-21: mid-point metrics snapshot ready
- 2026-12-28: dry-run with product on the demo
- 2027-01-05: final slide deck and decision memo to have on record (I’ll upload to the HubSpot deal and shared Drive)

Notes: procurement requested a clean SOW and a simplified pricing appendix (they asked for ballpark numbers so procurement can speed internal approvals). I drafted a pricing appendix and will share it in the drive link.

Please reply with any conflicts for the 2027-01-07 11:00 PT slot.

Thanks,
Camila
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@carelogix.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Dr. Elena Soto <elena.soto@carelogix.com>
Cc: procurement@carelogix.com, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC scope and timeline

Camila / team —

Thanks — confirmed: sample export (anonymized) will be uploaded to the shared S3 by 2026-12-06 EOD. Procurement lead is Priya Natarajan (procurement@carelogix.com) and she’s copied on this message.

We’re good with the hybrid model — happy to test Redwood Private VPC connector during the POC (we’ll provide the infra contact for the VPC peering).

Final readout: Priya and I discussed internally; the exec review on 2027-01-07 11:00 PT works for us. For clarity on the decision gate, we’ll be looking for:
- Clinical accuracy: at least 88% entity-level F1 on the gold set
- Redaction: 100% recall on PHI categories in test set
- Latency: P95 < 700ms for 99% of test prompts

If we meet those thresholds, procurement will move to a short-form purchase order and we’ll scope the Dedicated/Private licensing in parallel.

I’ll have Priya confirm procurement timeline (she’s started the internal paperwork). See you in the kickoff next week.

—Marcus
Senior Product Manager, CareLogix
